def read_xyz(p):
    L=open(p).read().split('\n')
    n=int(L[0]); ats=[]; xyz=[]
    for line in L[2:2+n]:
        t=line.split(); ats.append(t[0]); xyz.append([float(v) for v in t[1:4]])
    return ats, np.array(xyz)

def write_xyz(p, ats, xyz, comment):
    with open(p,'w') as f:
        f.write(f"{len(ats)}\n{comment}\n")
        for a,v in zip(ats,xyz):
            f.write(f"{a} {v[0]:.6f} {v[1]:.6f} {v[2]:.6f}\n")

def rot_axis_angle(axis, theta):
    ax=np.array(axis,dtype=float); ax/=np.linalg.norm(ax)
    c,s=np.cos(theta),np.sin(theta); x,y,z=ax
    return np.array([[c+x*x*(1-c), x*y*(1-c)-z*s, x*z*(1-c)+y*s],
                     [y*x*(1-c)+z*s, c+y*y*(1-c), y*z*(1-c)-x*s],
                     [z*x*(1-c)-y*s, z*y*(1-c)+x*s, c+z*z*(1-c)]])

def place_fragment(fats, fxyz, pA, pB, pC, dA, dB, dC):
    """rigid transform: fragment anchors pA,pB,pC -> targets dA,dB,dC"""
    P=np.array([pA,pB,pC],dtype=float); D=np.array([dA,dB,dC],dtype=float)
    Pc=P.mean(0); Dc=D.mean(0)
    Pv=P-Pc; Dv=D-Dc
    H=Pv.T@Dv
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    return (fxyz-Pc)@R.T + Dc

ats_ph, ph = read_xyz('frag/phen.xyz')

# ring anchors: C0, N1, N5
rC0, rN1, rN5 = ring[0], ring[1], ring[5]
# local frame of ring: y = bisector (C0 -> ring center direction), z = normal
bis = (rN1+rN5)/2.0
ydir = bis - rC0; ydir/=np.linalg.norm(ydir)
zdir = np.cross(rN1-rC0, rN5-rC0); zdir/=np.linalg.norm(zdir)

    global atoms, coords
    # targets: N->Cipso 1.44 along ydir; ring plane normal = xdir*sign-ish
    dCipso = Npos + 1.44*ydir
    nrm = xdir*sign
    # ortho carbons: in plane perpendicular to nrm, around Cipso
    # build in-plane basis: u = ydir component perpendicular to nrm, v = nrm x u
    u = ydir - np.dot(ydir,nrm)*nrm; u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
    v = np.cross(nrm,u)
    ang=np.deg2rad(60)
    dO1 = dCipso + 1.40*(np.cos(ang)*u + np.sin(ang)*v)
    dO2 = dCipso + 1.40*(np.cos(ang)*u - np.sin(ang)*v)
    P = place_fragment(ats_ph, ph, ph[0], ph[1], ph[5], dCipso, dO1, dO2)
    base=len(atoms)
    for i in range(6,10):  # skip ipso/ortho carbons? no: keep all C (0-5), skip ipso H(6); keep H 7,8,9
        pass
    # add carbons 0..5 and H 7,8,9 (skip ipso H index6)
    idx=[0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9]
    for i in idx:
        atoms.append(ats_ph[i]); coords.append(P[i])
    # iPr groups on ortho carbons (template idx1 and idx5)
    for oi, sgn in ((1, +1), (5, -1)):
        Cip = P[0]; Co = P[oi]
        dirv = Co-Cip; dirv/=np.linalg.norm(dirv)
        CH = Co + 1.52*dirv
        atoms.append('C'); coords.append(CH)
        # in-plane directions for methyls: perpendicular within ring plane
        nrmP = np.cross(P[1]-P[0], P[5]-P[0]); nrmP/=np.linalg.norm(nrmP)
        w1 = np.cross(dirv, nrmP); w1/=np.linalg.norm(w1)
        a=np.deg2rad(55)
        m1 = CH + 1.53*(np.cos(a)*w1 + np.sin(a)*nrmP)
        m2 = CH + 1.53*(np.cos(a)*w1 - np.sin(a)*nrmP)

            dvec = (cm-CH)/np.linalg.norm(cm-CH)
            p1 = np.cross(dvec, np.array([0,0,1.0]))
            if np.linalg.norm(p1)<1e-6: p1=np.cross(dvec,np.array([1.0,0,0]))
            p1/=np.linalg.norm(p1); p2=np.cross(dvec,p1)
            for j in range(3):
                th=np.deg2rad(120*j+30)
                hd = np.cos(th)*p1+np.sin(th)*p2
                # tilt slightly: keep pure perpendicular
                atoms.append('H'); coords.append(cm+1.09*hd)
    return base

add_ipr(N5pos, -1)

print('IPr atoms:', len(atoms))

    a=np.array(a,float); a/=np.linalg.norm(a); b=np.array(b,float); b/=np.linalg.norm(b)
    v=np.cross(a,b); c=np.dot(a,b)
    if np.linalg.norm(v)<1e-9:

    vx=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*(1/(1+c))

    """rotation mapping local y->b, z->n, x->w=b x n"""
    b=np.array(b,float); b/=np.linalg.norm(b); n=np.array(n,float)
    n=n-np.dot(n,b)*b; n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
